responsibility: Application lifecycle facade, headless frame pumping, lifecycle state ownership, deterministic application trace, and application composition wiring.

lifetime.creation: App::Init creates ApplicationRuntime through the explicit composition root
lifetime.shutdown: Quit is a request; Stopped is reached at a frame boundary or explicit runtime shutdown, then RAII destroys the runtime

threading.concurrency: Run owns the loop while active; PumpFrame is rejected during Run and no concurrent mutation route is provided

invariants.text: App initializes without SDL, Vulkan, ImGui, APaint, scene, or game dependencies.
Quit is a request and becomes Stopped only at the canonical safe frame boundary.
PumpFrame cannot execute while Run owns the application loop.
Headless manual pumping produces deterministic frame and lifecycle trace ordering through the public SDK.
